chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: O God, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And by the right of the Imams from among them, that You make me among those who deserve their intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of asking for intercession through the right of the Imams in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, emphasizes the Shia doctrine of *al-wilayah* and the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the theological emphasis on their spiritual authority as the means to divine proximity. It underscores the belief that adherence to the Imams is not merely ritualistic but essential for securing *shafa'ah* (intercession) on the Day of Resurrection, a key eschatological concept in Twelver Shi'ism.
